newsitem.title: INDIA: Truck spills boulders on India pilgrims, kills 50.
newsitem.headline: Truck spills boulders on India pilgrims, kills 50.

text.p: At least 50 Hindu pilgrims were killed in eastern India when a truck overturned spilling heavy boulders, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said on Tuesday.

The news agency quoted local officials as saying five people were injured when the truck toppled the boulders on the pilgrims, who were returning on Monday night from the temple town of Deoghar in Bihar state.
The accident took place at Fatua town, near the Bihar capital Patna, it said.
The news agency did not say whether the pilgrims were travelling in the truck when it overturned or what caused the accident.
